This three-part regimen, featuring our Pain Mukt Powder, Nerves Power Oil, and Pain Mukt Essence, works together to soothe discomfort, reduce inflammation, and improve mobility. Each product is formulated with pure and natural Ayurvedic ingredients, offering a holistic approach to managing pain and enhancing your quality of life.

Nerves Power Oil: An external oil that improves nerve and muscle function, reduces stiffness and numbness, and boosts mobility and flexibility.
Pain Mukt Essence: This essence relieves arthritis and joint pain, helps with spondylitis and frozen shoulder, and encourages muscular relaxation, promoting better bone and muscle health.
